title: The Third Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC 3.0) of the Republic of Mauritius
organization: Republic of Mauritius; submitted to the UNFCCC
temporal_coverage: Historical and current conditions; projections and policy targets through 2050–2100.
methodology: National NDC synthesizes sector data, projections and stakeholder consultation.
limitations: National aggregates; implementation often conditional on finance, technology and capacity.

title: Annual Report on Performance FY 2024-2025: Ministry of Environment, Solid Waste Management and Climate Change
organization: Government of Mauritius, Environment and Climate Change Division
temporal_coverage: Ministry performance for FY 2024-2025; reports coastal-risk assessment activities through June 2025.
methodology: Ministry performance report summarizes activities and outputs for FY 2024-2025.
limitations: Government self-report; no independent evaluation of risk-reduction outcomes.

title: Coastal Life and Resilience: Diversifying livelihoods and building resilience of coastal communities on Rodrigues Island, Mauritius
organization: United Nations Development Programme, GEF Small Grants Programme
temporal_coverage: Community-based adaptation project launched in 2015; story reports activities and outcomes through 2020; page date unstated.
methodology: UNDP story reports a 2015 community-based adaptation project and consultations in Baie du Nord.
limitations: Programme narrative, not an independent impact evaluation.

title: DRR (Floods and Flash Floods)
organization: Government of Mauritius, Observatoire de l'Environnement
temporal_coverage: Reports flood events from 2008 through 2024 and summarizes the Land Drainage Master Plan released in 2025; webpage date unstated.
methodology: Official observatory page summarizes past flood impacts and Land Drainage Master Plan zones and recommendations.
limitations: Summary page, not the plan's technical appendices; it says 16 high-risk sites but enumerates 15 numbered entries.

title: Perception of Climate Change Adaptation in Rodrigues Island
organization: Charles Telfair Centre; author Marie Stéphania Perrine
temporal_coverage: Case-study observations on climate perceptions, livelihoods and adaptation; study period and webpage date are unstated; includes a January-April 2018 example.
methodology: Case study using 110 open-ended questionnaires and 12 snowball-sampled key-informant interviews.
limitations: Convenience respondents and non-probability informants; not a representative survey, and study date is unstated.

title: Why have water shortages in Mauritius sparked the worst civil unrest in recent years?
organization: Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project (ACLED)
temporal_coverage: Analyst article reports water-protest events in October 2026 and notes protests in response to water shortages since 2020.
methodology: ACLED analyst narrates protest events and water-cut chronology in October 2026.
limitations: Article does not attribute water cuts to climate change; it names cost-of-living pressures and a police shooting.
